title: AI doesn't generate working products, that's still your job

title: You Could Have Come Up With Kimi Delta Attention

highlights: Kimi Delta Attention的提出并非偶然，而是基于对注意力机制本质的深刻洞察。
文章展示了如何从基础概念出发，逐步推导出Delta Attention的改进方案。
作者强调，通过系统思考和实验验证，任何人都可能独立提出类似创新。

title: GPU Management: Why Idle GPUs Are the New Grounded Aircraft

title: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
summary: OlmoEarth is a geospatial inference platform by AI2 that enables planetary-scale analysis by combining a large-scale geospatial data infrastructure with a family of vision-language models. It supports tasks like flood detection, land cover classification, and disaster response through a flexible API and open datasets.
highlights: OlmoEarth provides a unified platform for geospatial inference at planetary scale.
It integrates a massive geospatial data pipeline with fine-tuned vision-language models.
The platform supports diverse applications including flood mapping and land cover analysis.
Open datasets and model weights are released to foster reproducibility and research.
